body.statement: For explicit finite-domain instances whose undirected full causal graph has exactly one cycle, does the two-arc reachability augmentation specified by \(\operatorname{UnicycleHandle}\) yield a sound-and-complete polynomial-size certificate calculus and polynomial-time decision algorithm, or can the shared-selector hardness mechanism be embedded already in this class? Give either the complete composition theorem or a restriction-preserving hardness reduction.
body.justification: This is the first structural boundary beyond a full polyforest and exposes the genuinely open content without asserting general treewidth fixed-parameter tractability.
body.gap: Neither Beckers2025Actual nor the Halpern--Pearl decomposition literature classifies reachability-sensitive deletion semantics on a single full-graph cycle.
body.consumer: The answer determines the next exact structural dispatch supported by the backend after forests.
